comparison_receipt_semantics: Execution PASS is not equality. Native comparison.json statuses are retained verbatim, including original failures and null controls.
credential_scan: All selected bytes scanned for listed categories; no match. Not a claim to detect every possible secret format.
determinism: Sorted USTAR members; mode0644; uid/gid/mtime0; empty user/group/gzip filename; gzip mtime0. Same frozen inputs/toolchain yield identical archive bytes.

excluded.reason: Never read, copied, hashed or archived. Command records retain executable path names only; no environment dumps.

Reconstruct from pinned revisions, package locks, source audit manifests and diagnostic patches. Selected standalone src/main.rs and two explicitly modified Vakint source files are included individually.
excluded.scope: Complete source trees, git/jj metadata, targets, binaries, caches and external executable files

excluded.reason: Native receipts and preparation/independent notation proofs retain exact hashes and lengths. Regenerate using complete archived pre-network inputs, immutable executor build inputs and the unchanged checker source. No scalar output is silently treated as archived.
excluded.scope: All resolved large scalar outputs and normalized coefficient copies

excluded.reason: Successful complete inputs and exact certificates are included. Failed preparation scripts/logs are preserved; duplicate incomplete output copies are not needed to regenerate the failures.
Dependency identities remain in Cargo.lock, recipes and source pin/audit records; full repeated Cargo metadata is not causal trace evidence.
Oversized derived inventory; not used for causal claims. Its bounded regeneration script and failed/limited-scope log are included.

prior_archive.scope: Required companion archive for older native captures, original failed numerical oracle, and source provenance. Selected exact prerequisites are additionally bundled under prior/. Source trees and binaries must be regenerated from recorded revisions, lockfiles, source audits and patches.
